title: Level A2 Intensive French
description: Sequel to FRAN 100. Development of upper-beginner language skills and intercultural competencies to facilitate communication and interaction in simple, routine situations (description of background and needs; frequently used expressions), through oral and written practice. Exploration of differences and cultural diversities in French-speaking regions and countries. Advances to an A2 level of the European Common Framework for Languages. Prepares for intermediate (B1) study upon completion.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of FRAN 120, FREN 106, FREN 107, FREN 160.
Normal entry point for students with French 11.
Not open to students with French 12 in the last two years, or French Immersion to Grade 8.
